errors.session_only: only a signed-in person can do this from their own session; API keys and the no-login session cannot
errors.not_a_member: you are not a member of that workspace
errors.transfer_owner_only: only the workspace owner can transfer it
errors.transfer_user_required: user_id required: the member who becomes the owner
errors.transfer_target_not_member: ownership can only go to a member of the workspace; add them first

owns_shared_workspaces.one: you own a workspace other people use ({workspaces}); transfer it to another member or delete it before deleting your account
owns_shared_workspaces.other: you own {count} workspaces other people use ({workspaces}); transfer each one to another member or delete it before deleting your account

errors.still_owns_workspaces: the account still owns a workspace; transfer or delete it first
errors.purge_unavailable: this install cannot erase workspaces, so an account that owns one cannot be deleted here
errors.purge_failed: erasing workspace {workspace} failed; your account was not deleted, try again

audit.workspace_deleted: Workspace permanently erased with its owner's account: {workspace}

account_deleted.one: Account deleted with the workspace it owned ({keys} API keys revoked elsewhere)
account_deleted.other: Account deleted with the {count} workspaces it owned ({keys} API keys revoked elsewhere)

log.set_last_workspace: account: remember last workspace for user {user}
log.transfer_bump_version: account: bump token version after transfer for user {user}
log.last_workspace: account: read last workspace for user {user}
log.transfer_reissue: account: re-issue the session after transfer for user {user}
